title: Investigating Energy Efficiency and Performance Trade-offs in LLM Inference Across Tasks and DVFS Settings
summary_zh: 一項受控的因子量測研究，將 GPU 核心頻率視為自變數，在 NVIDIA A100 上橫跨六個模型與生成、問答、摘要三類任務進行 DVFS 掃描（210–1410 MHz）。關鍵結論是階段不對稱的時脈敏感性：計算受限的 prefill 對頻率敏感，而記憶體頻寬受限的 decode 大致不受頻率影響；總能耗曲線為非單調，最低時脈反而最耗能（約 400,000 J），最小值落在高時脈段（約 180,000 J）。此結果佐證了我們的延遲預測器為何將時脈建模為隨負載變化的項，以及為何 decode 服務維持於加速狀態。
summary_en: A controlled factorial measurement study that treats GPU core frequency as an independent variable, sweeping DVFS (210–1410 MHz) on an NVIDIA A100 across six models and the generation, question-answering, and summarization task families. The key result is phase-asymmetric clock sensitivity: the compute-bound prefill phase is frequency-sensitive while the memory-bandwidth-bound decode phase is largely frequency-insensitive; the total-energy curve is non-monotone, with the lowest clock being the most energy-hungry (about 400,000 J) and the minimum sitting in the upper-clock band (about 180,000 J). This corroborates why our latency predictor models the clock as a load-dependent term and why decode-serving stays at boost.
